candidates.feature_name: Unity Project Readonly Resource And Script Overview Tool
candidates.description: Generate a readonly EditorWindow that scans scripts, scenes, prefabs, materials, and textures, then exports a Markdown report.
candidates.value: Gives the project a safe in-Unity overview tool for future automation work.

candidates.description: Scan prefab, scene, material, and ScriptableObject YAML files for empty GUIDs, missing script markers, and suspicious local references.
candidates.value: Finds project hygiene issues without touching assets.

candidates.description: Generate a static report for MonoBehaviour lifecycle methods, public fields, and SerializeField usage.
candidates.value: Highlights maintainability hotspots and helps plan refactors.
candidates.status_note: Generated code to the configured Unity path without overwriting existing files.

candidates.description: Create an Editor menu command that runs non-destructive checks and writes a validation report.
candidates.value: Makes repeat validation accessible inside Unity.

candidates.description: Add runtime tracking for play session metrics. This touches gameplay code and should be implemented only after manual review.
candidates.value: Could improve telemetry for balancing and debugging.

candidates.description: Add a reusable runtime component for timed buffs, debuffs, slows, and regeneration that can be attached to character prefabs manually.
candidates.value: Extends the existing character/combat foundation without editing existing scripts.
candidates.status_note: Generated a new feature script to the configured Unity path without overwriting existing files.

candidates.description: Add a standalone runtime morale component with decay, recovery, threshold events, and task-readiness helpers for worker gameplay.
candidates.value: Builds on the worker/task system with a new balancing lever.

candidates.description: Add a runtime resource-threshold component that tracks named resource amounts and raises events when stock falls below configured limits.
candidates.value: Provides a low-risk foundation for UI alerts, worker priorities, and colony feedback.

candidates.description: Add a runtime event-feed component for damage, healing, deaths, and combat notes so UI or debugging tools can subscribe without coupling to combat classes.
candidates.value: Makes combat feedback easier to surface while keeping the generated code isolated.

candidates.description: Standalone runtime component that draws a box on the terrain and selects any selectable objects inside, supporting RTS-style unit selection.
candidates.value: Provides a common RTS control mechanism without modifying existing input or selection systems.

candidates.description: A standalone script that smoothly zooms the camera toward a double-clicked world position, compatible with existing camera movement.
candidates.value: Improves navigation and player experience without altering the active camera controller.

candidates.description: Attach to any resource holder to slowly reduce stockpiles over time based on configurable decay rates and environmental conditions.
candidates.value: Adds a strategic layer to resource management without touching existing storage or consumption logic.

candidates.description: Simple component that spawns temporary on-screen text notifications (e.g., 'Worker idle', 'Research complete') using a provided prefab template.
candidates.value: Gives immediate in-game feedback for important events without coupling UI to core systems.
